title: Postmortem
description: A structured, repository-backed record of one betting day's postmortem -- supplied after the day is complete (typically as a ChatGPT-to-Claude handoff), never generated by guessing at analytical content. Distinct from the auto-computed reports/<date>_postmortem.json (which is pure arithmetic over the canonical ledger): this record carries the human/model ANALYTICAL narrative (wins, misses, process errors, proposed investigations) plus its own linkage to the real canonical bets it discusses. See lib/edgelab/postmortems.py.

postmortemId.description: sha1('postmortem' + gameDate) -- one logical postmortem per calendar date; corrections are new revisions of the SAME postmortemId, not a new one. See lib/edgelab/ids.py:build_postmortem_id.

revision.description: 1 for the first import, incremented on each explicit correction. Never decremented, never reused.

recordStatus.description: CORRECTED marks a prior revision superseded by a later one -- history is kept (see revisionHistory), never overwritten in place.

supersededBy.description: The revision number that superseded this one, when recordStatus is CORRECTED. Null for the current (ACTIVE) revision.

markdownPath.description: Repo-relative path to this revision's human-readable postmortem.md

linkedBetIds.description: Canonical PlacedBet.betId values this postmortem discusses -- every entry MUST already exist in data/edgelab/bets/bets.jsonl at import time (lib.edgelab.postmortems.write_postmortem refuses to link a betId it cannot find, never substitutes a recommendation or a guessed id in its place).

unresolvedBetReferences.description: Caller-supplied bet references (e.g. 'SF F5 $12') that could not be resolved to a real betId -- kept for visibility rather than silently dropped or guessed.

reportedTotals.description: The daily record as SUPPLIED in the import payload (totalRisked/totalReturned/netProfitLoss/roi) -- preserved verbatim, never silently replaced.

canonicalTotals.description: The SAME four figures, independently recomputed from linkedBetIds against the canonical ledger at import time -- the source of truth for any report regeneration. Never itself supplied by the caller.

totalsMatch.description: reportedTotals == canonicalTotals (within rounding). False is not an error -- it is surfaced so a discrepancy is visible, never silently reconciled in either direction.

performanceByMarketFamily.description: Caller-supplied per-family breakdown; structure is free-form (families/metrics evolve), preserved as given.

analyticalWins.description: What the analysis correctly identified, as supplied -- never fabricated or inferred from settlement results alone.

analyticalMisses.description: What the analysis got wrong, as supplied.

processErrors.description: Operational/process mistakes noted for the day (e.g. a bet logged late, a market misread), as supplied.

proposedInvestigations.description: Proposed model or risk-rule investigations arising from this postmortem, as supplied. Never itself a change to production probabilities/thresholds/risk-gate behavior -- purely a recorded proposal.

structuredFindings.description: The raw structured JSON findings payload exactly as supplied, preserved verbatim for any field this schema doesn't explicitly break out.
